dataset: DIANA I: the Safaitic dictionary of Al-Jallad 2026 (version 2026.1), one row per headword of the dictionary proper and the toponym glossary, and per name of the Group Names and Divine Names lists

source.work: Al-Jallad, Ahmad, Dictionary of the Inscriptions of Ancient North Arabia, Volume I: Safaitic, version 2026.1, Online Corpus of the Inscriptions of Ancient North Arabia (OCIANA), Columbus, Ohio 2026, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23847496
source.text_layer: the PDF's own (born-digital), read with PyMuPDF

notation.alphabet: ʾ ʿ b d ḏ ḍ f g ġ h ḫ ḥ k l m n q r s ś ṣ t ṯ ṭ w y z ẓ (s¹ s² printed s ś)
notation.homograph: a superscript digit in print; stored as an integer, headword_printed keeps it
notation.languages: the book's tags (CAr, NAr, Hbr, Arm, Gz, Sab, Ug; His, Dad, GrAr …) as the names its List of Abbreviations gives

identity_rule: diana:p<pdf page>#<n>, n the headword's place among those that begin on that page; an entry running over a page keeps its first page
license_note: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (© 2026 Ahmad Al-Jallad): the entries as printed, with their pages, for non-commercial reference; the entries' text unchanged, in another format, beside the index fields forms and match_keys
